entities.summary: Josh Wardle is a Welsh software engineer best known for developing the viral web-based word game Wordle and the collaborative experimental project r/place for Reddit. In January 2022, The New York Times Company acquired Wordle from Wardle for a seven-figure sum. He lives in Brooklyn, New York. Wardle was named one of TIME's 100 Most Influential People of the year in 2022.
